title: Robots-Dont-Cry: Understanding Falsely Anthropomorphic Utterances in Dialog Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on the feasibility and comfort of anthropomorphic utterances in dialog systems (the 'Robots-Dont-Cry' dataset). While it references the 'moral imperative' of truthful systems and the 'ethics of robotic deception' as motivation, the evaluation itself measures user perceptions of machine identity and truthfulness rather than benchmarking moral reasoning, religious topics, or specific ethical frameworks.
